journey.title: Inspect an asset and take it into a page
journey.purpose: A maintainer finds a component, inspects its fixtures and evidence, then carries the same version and story into the Design studio without losing context.

steps.intent: Find the component for the surface being changed.
Inspect the fixtures, checks and asset data without leaving the component.
Place the same version and story into the scenario page and review the composition.

claims.statement: The component version, story and evidence context survive the move from the catalog into the design studio.
claims.rationale: The D · Nocturne flow is a design target, not a runtime journey executor; this claim records the intended cross-page behavior without pretending it is proven.
